SeeAnchor Bible Dictionary(1992), “Travel and Communication,” 6:644–46. Because of the high risk of being attacked by robbers while traveling in the ancient world, people would rarely travel alone, as the characters in the parable do, which is another clue that the account is well understood as a similitude.
